note: Rectangles [x, y, w, h] in viewport px, rounded to 0.01. Mock default context (theme, density, text scale); the start screen, no plugin screen. Measured on a machine with load average 9.00 6.80 7.23 (1, 5, 15 min at run start; uptime read 14.74 13.54 11.19 before writing the script). Each scene in a fresh page; animations and transitions are frozen (a style that sets animation and transition to none) before each reading, the panel rectangle is read once it is the same on three frames. Sources `alpha` and `beta` are not plugins of the mock: it names a source by its capitalised id (Alpha, Beta), so rows are neutral. The plugin-health condition is the mock's own `health:flux` (Shell.plugins.report('flux', { service: 'failed', ... })): the mock has no neutral plugin, so its Source cell reads the mock's own plugin name (Flux). The panel shows ONE tool view at a time (`.panel__view:not([hidden])`; the other tool views stay in the DOM, hidden, inert, aria-hidden). Operation ids are random: data-key reads `operation:op-ID` here. Durations and ages ("just now", "under 1 s") are volatile. A row is a `tr.click` with tabindex 0 and no role. The tab dot is `` and its label is a `.visually-hidden` span (", ") inside the tab; the count is ` N`. The dot of the accent tone (no data-tone match) is not reachable from the two tools (they raise error or warning only) and is not measured. Mock behaviour the real tools should not copy blindly (measured, in both engines): the Problems table's pinned Condition column renders 37px (webkit) / 14px (chromium) wide although its th carries --fit-w: 886px (th.fit-w1 has width 1% and a min-width the engines ignore), so the Condition label is clipped to its glyph; the Operations Progress cell's `.cell-measure` (min-width = viz 48 + gap 8 + 12ch) is wider than the 124.5px content box of the 144.5px column, so "6 of 14 jobs" / "2 of 5" / "40%" spill under the Started cell and read clipped; an indeterminate operation draws no bar (the dim em dash, aria-label "No progress reported"). The `overflow` of each row lists the cells whose content ellipsizes or spills. Paint: every computed style is an entry of `styles` ({ color, backgroundColor, border, fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight, lineHeight, borderRadius, opacity }) and a part of `paint` (and the hover reading) holds its index; the paint of 1440x900 is stored in full, at 1280x800 only the parts that differ (absent = same as 1440x900); the strip parts (tabs, header, panel) are kept in problems-rows and tab-badges only.
